description: Dual Connectivity for Seamless Switching: Experience ultimate flexibility with Bluetooth + 2.4GHz wireless connectivity. Easily switch between devices using the included USB receiver or Bluetooth mode for uninterrupted workflow. Multi-Device Pairing Made Easy: Connect and toggle between multiple devices effortlessly, making it perfect for multitasking across laptops, tablets, and desktops. Precision Control with Adjustable DPI: Customize your cursor speed with adjustable sensitivity up to 2400 DPI (800/1200/1600/2400) for smooth tracking, whether you’re working, browsing, or designing. Ergonomic Thumb-Rest Design: Designed for long hours of comfort, the built-in thumb rest and natural contour reduce wrist strain and provide a relaxed grip for all-day productivity. Silent & Noise-Free Clicks: Enjoy distraction-free usage with ultra-quiet buttons, making it ideal for offices, libraries, and late-night work sessions. Type-C Rechargeable Convenience: Equipped with a modern Type-C rechargeable battery, eliminating the need for constant battery replacements while ensuring long-lasting performance. Wide Compatibility Across Devices: Fully compatible with Windows & macOS, ensuring plug-and-play convenience across all your devices.
